title: Add new ! filters to the ui Like the other system filters I want two new ones: !running - Only shows collumns with tasks running in !tasked - Only shows collumns that have tasks in As always this should have no affect on the backend. Each of these should be able to keep up as things change columns over time without needing a page refresh. This is just to allow the user to better review things and keep an eye on where active tasks are. As a  non-tag filter they should use an exclamation mark in the search bar to filter.
goal:
# Add new ! filters to the ui

Like the other system filters I want two new ones:
!running - Only shows collumns with tasks running in
!tasked - Only shows collumns that have tasks in

As always this should have no affect on the backend. Each of these should be able to keep up as things change columns over time without needing a page refresh. This is just to allow the user to better review things and keep an eye on where active tasks are. As a  non-tag filter they should use an exclamation mark in the search bar to filter.
body:
# Add new ! filters to the ui

Like the other system filters I want two new ones:
!running - Only shows collumns with tasks running in
!tasked - Only shows collumns that have tasks in

As always this should have no affect on the backend. Each of these should be able to keep up as things change columns over time without needing a page refresh. This is just to allow the user to better review things and keep an eye on where active tasks are. As a  non-tag filter they should use an exclamation mark in the search bar to filter.
